# The examples' build control reads as a setting, at a setting's size

## Context

Finding 3 of the #21140 gate read ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)): in both reads (Thu 19 and Fri 20 Nov), neither cold reader could tell what "Running the production build" switches, and the control was as large as the main button. On 20 Nov, Clio, the epic's steward, ruled on it after a ranked read by two cold readers ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767)): "Examples open in: Production build ▾", 36 px high in regular weight. She assigned the build to Ada, with before and after frames at 1440 and 390. This ticket is filed beside #21140, which holds 40 subs. It carries no contributor labels because it is owned and due before the Sun 22 Nov 17:00Z lock.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` at `beb8fa94c9` (which includes #21575), 1440 × 900, dark theme:

- The control reads "Running the production build". Both readers took that for a status line, not a setting.
- The control is 257 × 48 px with 16 px semibold text. The page's main action, "Open the 100,000 × 200 grid", is 243 × 48 px and semibold. #21575 made the control's fill neutral but left its size and weight unchanged.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Portal.view.examples.MainContainer#buildModes`: each build carries `text` for the menu and `status` for the control's label. `createBuildControl()` binds the label to `status`. The overview, every group page and the find results show the control.
- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/MainContainer.css`, `.portal-examples-build-control.neo-button`: sets `font-size: 14px`, which reaches no text, because the label reads `--button-text-font-size` (16 px) and the glyph has its own 12 px. Height and weight come from the theme's large button (`--cmp-button-height`, 48 px) and `--button-text-font-weight` (semibold).
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`: `selectBuild()` finds the control by the name `/^Running /`, and the build test expects "Running the ESM build".
- #20690 placed the control: "maintainers verify builds through them. They move, they do not go." The four builds and their routes stay.

Design authority: Clio's ruling on #21140, "'Examples open in: Production build ▾', 36 px high in regular weight" ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767)).

## The Fix

1. The label becomes "Examples open in: " followed by the selected build's `text`. `status` is removed from `buildModes`.
2. `.portal-examples-build-control.neo-button` sets `--button-height: 36px` and `--button-text-font-weight: var(--core-fontweight-regular)`. The dead `font-size: 14px` becomes `--button-text-font-size: 14px`.
3. The spec finds the control by its new name. The build test asserts the label, a 36 px height and a regular weight; these assertions are red on `dev` and green at head.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] For each of the four builds, the control reads "Examples open in: <build>", and its menu and the four build routes are unchanged.
- [ ] At 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 the control is 36 px high with regular-weight text. The new assertion is red on `dev` and green at head.
- [ ] The PR carries before and after frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, dark theme.

## Out of Scope

- Naming the other builds before the menu opens: the ruling accepts this for a developer's setting.
- Findings 7 (Vega) and 9 (Maryam), and the name of the "All examples" row, which goes to tomorrow's whole read.
